Morphological erode/dilate with iteration control.

假红外

漂白旁路

饱和度 / 活泼度

通道混合

线性运动模糊
Directional linear motion blur: centered tap line along a user angle with compile-time sample-count presets

三路色调

信号毛刺
Digital signal glitch: hash-activated horizontal band displacement with RGB channel split, deterministic per band

变形镜头拉丝
Horizontal anamorphic lens streak: highlight-gated taps along +/-X with distance falloff, quality presets and tintable streak color

万花筒镜像
Fold-mirror kaleidoscope: horizontal / vertical / quad folding about an adjustable axis plus diagonal reflection, mix-controlled

径向模糊 Pro
Zoom/radial blur along center-to-pixel rays with compile-time sample-count presets and adjustable center

色彩空间转换器
Professional color space and gamma converter with tone mapping and white point adaptation

像素块
Mosaic pixelation with per-block center sampling, linear color quantization and optional 4x4 ordered dither

日转夜转换
Heuristic day-for-night look: luminance-weighted exposure pull-down, cool temperature shift, sky highlight protection and a slight moonlight blue lift; HDR-safe with no output clamping

扩展光晕
Highlight diffusion glow with hue-adjustable tint (halation variant, alternating-direction ring kernel)

交叉冲洗
Cross-process film look family: crossed rational channel curves with dye-fog crosstalk between channels

反锐化锐化
Unsharp mask sharpening: compile-time 3x3/5x5 inverse-distance kernel, radius to 8 px and edge-gated detail amplification

Warm Tint
Adds a gentle warm tint; declares OpenGL export support (W06 deliverable-plugin slice).

网点印刷
Halftone print screening: rotated constant-matrix dot lattice, luminance-sized dots with soft anti-aliased coverage

镜头畸变
Radial lens distortion (barrel/pincushion) with r2 polynomial remap, manual zoom compensation and auto-zoom framing guard

柔光泛光
Threshold-based soft glow and bloom with multi-pass ring blur approximation

渐变曝光滤镜
Rotatable graduated ND exposure filter: smoothstep feathered linear ramp of exposure stops along a user angle

多形状暗角
Multi-shape vignette (ellipse / rectangle / circle) with smoothstep feather, strength blend and mean-preserving luma compensation

CRT 扫描线
CRT display emulation: triangle-wave scanlines and offset-triangle aperture grille mask, brightness-neutral multiplicative gains

移轴焦点
Tilt-shift miniature look: orientation-selectable focus band with smoothstep falloff driving a fixed 17-tap disc blur radius

高通磨皮
Frequency-domain skin retouching using high-pass filtering (band-stop filter)

棱镜色散
Rotatable radial RGB dispersion: channel-split sampling grows with center distance and adjustable edge falloff

双色调
Duotone/tritone luminance ramp: linear shadow-to-highlight color map with detail keep-back and selectable luma source

胶片颗粒
Film-style monochrome grain: smooth hash value-noise lattice modulated by luminance, with shadow/highlight bias
